scope: sim only; default-off short fine-tune probe. Training waits for the operator report and Changmin approval (Claude decision 2026-10-19: branch/data/config diff/offline-gate prep only).

approval_and_spec.gpu_gate_change: Claude decision 2026-10-19: the R3 GPU evaluation gate is relaxed from 'behind a checkpoint with P>=9/12' to 'offline gates g1-g5 all pass'. The original H1 basis was refuted on the lookback path.

purpose: The done head is a pwm-clock fingerprint: TRAIN200 grasp done rows are all at teacher pe 11.2-11.3 s and the pilot teacher hold ends at pe 10.3 s. R3 widens the grasp done label window to K=10 local rows so the completion head can fire without a lookback and without the exact teacher clock. R3 does not change the evaluation contract, the .65 threshold or the policy inputs.

variant_selection.rule: C2a PASS or INCONCLUSIVE -> R3-A. C2a FAIL -> R3-B. If the C2a result has not arrived at training start, run R3-A and mark the conditional status in launch.json; never choose by observed R3 training loss.
variant_selection.c2a_status_at_prep_utc: not arrived; no C2a result file existed under outputs/runs at 2026-10-19T20:05:32Z
variant_selection.conditional_record: launch.json must record the C2a verdict artifact path and sha256, or 'absent' for R3-A

R3-A.label_change: expand_done_window: each raw grasp completion row and the nine immediately preceding same-episode/skill rows at exactly 0.1 s become done=1. Release completion rows (a different skill) are unchanged; the window never crosses an episode or skill boundary.

R3-B.clock_jitter_scope: TRAIN rows whose teacher_phase is verify_lift or hold: add U(-1,+1) seconds to the two recorded clock state dims before normalization, clamp at 0, targets unchanged. No other row is augmented.

data_delta_dry_run.prior_note: The loss uses per-skill priors recomputed from the modified TRAIN h0 labels under the declared uniform-episode sampler. The spec's approximate '0.0277 (1/36)' is the pooled grasp-positive/total-row ratio (2000/72572 = 0.02756), not the per-skill grasp prior the balanced BCE uses (0.03651). Both are recorded; no constant is invented.

training.init_read_only: R8 is read-only; its SHA256 inventory is recomputed before and after training and recorded in launch.json.
training.precision_scope: fp32 weights/optimizer/grad clip; forward+loss bf16 autocast
training.run_root_contents: train/, eval/{R3v6,R3v7}-{ho4,train4}-rep{1,2,3}/, offline/, diff/, logs/, launch.json, prereg.json
training.command_shape: python3 scripts/act18_train.py --enabled --candidate act18-r3dw --precision bf16_autocast_v1 --init-checkpoint <R8 step-100000> --steps 10000 --done-window-ticks 10 --done-positive-batch-fraction 0.5 [--done-clock-jitter-s 1.0 for R3-B] --dataset <dataset-r1> --protocol experiments/2026-10-17-act18/protocol.json --queue <single-candidate queue.json> --out <run root>/train
training.queue_requirement: queue candidates must be exactly ['act18-r3dw'], training_precision=bf16_autocast_v1, dataset_manifest_sha256 and protocol_sha256 as above, and must pass scripts/check_current_stack.py --flow train before submission.

locked_splits.rule: VAL8 and FINAL40 stay locked: no evaluation, no best-val selection and no normalization use. TRAIN4 is a fit diagnostic only. HO4 is outside the demonstrations.
locked_splits.note: R3 results are not official gates and are never summed with the existing act18 results.

offline_gate.device: Oracle CPU only; GPU evaluation is forbidden until every gate passes

g1.definition: pilot teacher-state V0 replay: max temporal-ensemble done within hold end +/-10 ticks >= .65 in at least 3 of 4 worlds
g1.implemented_by: scripts/act18_r3_offline_gate.py pilot (pilot world list and input hashes embedded below)

g2.definition: no temporal-ensemble done >= .65 before the teacher verify_lift phase starts, 0 of 4 worlds

g3.definition: pilot lookback onset |delta| <= 5 ticks in at least 3 of 4 worlds (no regression from R8)

g4.definition: C2b S2(v7) student stopped state: done fires at least 4 of 6 lift worlds and at most 1 of 2 non-lift controls
g4.input_contract: {"schema":"ugrp.act18.r3_c2b_gate_input.v1","source_sha":...,"checkpoint_sha256":...,"worlds":[{"id":...,"role":"lift|control","done_fired":true|false}]} - the C2b owner must emit this adapter from its own raw result; no re-inference is allowed on Oracle.

g5.definition: E0 open-loop TRAIN4 teacher terminal rows: done probability >= .65 for 4 of 4 seeds
g5.implemented_by: scripts/act18_r3_offline_gate.py e0 --frames <R3 TRAIN4 open-loop frames.jsonl.gz> OR e0 --dataset <dataset-r1> --checkpoint <R3 checkpoint> (CPU positive-row inference)
g5.note: Validate the evaluator on the existing R8 frames file before trusting the R3 number; the R8 baseline must read 4/4.

offline_gate.PASS: g1 AND g2 AND g3 AND g4 AND g5. If any gate fails, R3 is closed as FAIL without GPU evaluation; the next candidate is R3b (separate command-history head).

closed_loop_evaluation.precondition: offline gate PASS and Changmin approval; R3 is not a GPU run before both

arms.R3v7: only if C2c was approved and executed; --issued-clock-deadband 2. If C2c was not approved, the R3 v7 arm is omitted and reported as such.
arms.R3v6: always run; pre-registered expectation is FAIL (student pe <= 2.1 s); recording only

closed_loop_evaluation.design: HO4 and TRAIN4, N=3, interleaved order, temporal_ensemble_coeff=.01, done threshold .65, --record-done-prob; baseline is the C2 B0 when code/environment match, else an R8 A0 HO4 anchor per boot; no pooling.
metrics: done probability max/p95 and first >= .65 tick pe
phase reach (lift/backoff onset/done/release entry/release physical success)

judgement.PASS_R3v7: G(HO4) >= 8 and G(TRAIN4) >= 8 and Pre(24) <= 1 and L(HO4) >= L(B0-HO4) - 2; if C2c ran, also G(HO4) >= G(C2c-HO4) + 3
judgement.FAIL: G(HO4) <= 3, or Pre >= 4/24, or (if C2c ran) G(HO4) <= G(C2c-HO4)
judgement.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; rerun seed 20261018 once and judge again
judgement.R3v6: not part of PASS/FAIL; G(HO4) >= 4 is reported as an exceptional 'fires without the clock' result

closed_loop_evaluation.ho4_harness_dependency: The base 95e668c59 act18_evaluate.py has no HO4 'diag' stage. HO4 evaluation must use the E2/C2 diag stage (--stage diag --diag-prereg) once that code is merged; until then only TRAIN4 can be run and HO4 is reported as not submitted.

reproduction.passing_arm_only: rerun training with seed 20261018 and the same checkpoint/data configuration; report the two results side by side and do not pool them

stop_conditions.offline_gate_any_failure: close R3 as FAIL; no GPU evaluation
stop_conditions.budget: gcp2 net cost stop is 2,000 KRW; stop immediately when the device fires or is imminent

risks: The window is anchored on grasp completion rows only; release positives stay at one row per episode and the release done head is unchanged.
K=10 covers the pilot hold-end pe 10.3 and dataset pe 11.3, but a student whose pe never reaches ~10 s still cannot fire; R3v6 is expected to fail for that reason.
The per-skill grasp prior rises 10x (0.00365 -> 0.03651). The spec's 0.0277 is a pooled approximation and is not used as the loss prior.
The window truncates the chunk target to h=0 for 2000 rows and shortens 3000 rows in total; this is pre-registered and recorded, not hidden.
R3-B jitter is applied on each access from a frozen per-row offset table (seed 20261017), not resampled per epoch; this is deterministic and recorded.
C2a has not reported; the R3-A/R3-B choice is conditional and must be recorded at launch.
HO4 closed-loop evaluation depends on the E2/C2 diag harness, which is not in this base branch.

The local Oracle dry-run used an image-free derived root with placeholder frames.json because the retrieval did not include JPEG metadata; labels/priors/targets are hash-verified and complete, but the VM must run the same dry-run on the full dataset before training.
